sources.title: deepseek-vl-7b-base: Text-to-Image model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview deepseek-vl-7b-base is an open-source vision-language model built by deepseek-ai that combines image understanding with text generation for real-world applications. The model uses a hybrid vision encoder combining SigLIP-L and SAM-B to process images up to 1024×1024 pixels, paired with a DeepSeek-LLM-7b-base language model trained on approximately 2 trillion text tokens.
